titleEs: Helltides.com vs Diablo4.life — single-purpose timer o multi-tool hub
titleEn: Helltides.com vs Diablo4.life — single-purpose timer or multi-tool hub
descriptionEs: Helltides.com es laser-focused en timing de Helltides. Diablo4.life es hub multi-purpose con Helltide + world boss + Legion + builds + tools.
descriptionEn: Helltides.com is laser-focused on Helltide timing. Diablo4.life is a multi-purpose hub with Helltide + world boss + Legion + builds + tools.
verdictEs: Helltides.com si solo quieres timer rápido para optimizar farm de cinders. Diablo4.life si quieres un hub centralizado para múltiples events + utilities + builds light.
verdictEn: Helltides.com if you just want a quick timer to optimize cinder farming. Diablo4.life if you want a centralized hub for multiple events + utilities + light builds.

useCases.reasonEs: Single-page tool con timer al toque. Diablo4.life requiere scrolear su dense home page para encontrar Helltide info entre otros events.
useCases.reasonEn: Single-page tool with at-a-glance timer. Diablo4.life requires scrolling its dense home page to find Helltide info among other events.

useCases.labelEs: World boss + Legion + Tree of Whispers timers en uno
useCases.labelEn: World boss + Legion + Tree of Whispers timers in one
useCases.reasonEs: Diablo4.life consolida múltiples events. Helltides.com cubre solo Helltides — para otros events otro tool.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo4.life consolidates multiple events. Helltides.com only covers Helltides — for other events you need another tool.

useCases.reasonEs: Helltides.com loads fast en mobile sin elementos extra. Diablo4.life es page densa que carga más slow.
useCases.reasonEn: Helltides.com loads fast on mobile without extra elements. Diablo4.life is a dense page that loads slower.

useCases.reasonEs: Diablo4.life agrega curated builds y class spotlight como sub-feature. Helltides.com no tiene builds — solo timer.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo4.life aggregates curated builds and class spotlight as a sub-feature. Helltides.com has no builds — only timer.

useCases.reasonEs: Diablo4.life consolida en un bookmark lo que Helltides.com + otros multiple tools harían separados.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo4.life consolidates in one bookmark what Helltides.com + other multiple tools would do separately.
